events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect sender check script usage and key files
events.input: $ sed -n 1,25p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs | cut -c1-200; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ | head; wc -c ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run live sender check with workshop key and the T-263 probe
events.input: $ K=$(sed -E 's/^[A-Z0-9_]+=//; s/^["'"'"']|["'"'"']$//g' ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key | head -1 | tr -d '[:space:]'); TANTRA_TEST_API_KEY="$K" node cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs [email]; echo "exit=$?"; TANTRA_TEST_API_KEY="$K" node cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs [email] boards@fintechcircle.com; echo "exit=$?"; unset K; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count probe results, update task, ack note
events.input: $ node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c '^PASS'; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c '^FAIL'; python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-263 status=review note="Ripple from T-418 applied: the live gate check now uses the tantra-workshop.key key, and today it passes for [email] (CONNECTED, exit 0) and answers 422 once a missing sender like boards@fintechcircle.com is added. The other FintechCircle senders are not in Tantra yet, so the full-pool gate depends on T-421 (Nelbin). probe-t263 passes 21 of 21 again; no code had to change." && python3 worksho
